newsitem.title: USA: EDS may take charge in Q2, sees 97 EPS $2.30-$2.35.
newsitem.headline: EDS may take charge in Q2, sees 97 EPS $2.30-$2.35.

text.p: Electronic Data Systems Corp said Thursday it believes it can achieve earnings for 1997 in the range of $2.30 to $2.35 per share, before a possible one-time charge later in the year.
The company said the charge could come as early as the second quarter.

EDS announced it is implementing an enterprise-wide business transformation initiative to reduce its costs, streamline its structure and align its strategy, services and delivery with market opportunities.

As a result of the transformation initiative, which is expected to extend into next year, the company said it expects to take the one-time charge. EDS said it anticipates that the cash savings that result from the initiative in 1997 will offset amounts paid for people-related charges.
The company reported earnings in the first quarter, ended March 31, of $194.1 million, or $0.40 a share, versus $218.8 million or $0.45 a share in the year-earlier period.
